direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt requires black-box reverse engineering of a compiled binary and an original executable replacement.
Parallel metadata shows actual parallel use, six subagents, artifact_ok true, and 292 of 391 official tests passed.
Status records completed official evaluation with process_ok true, artifact validation, and failed solution outcome.
Official evaluator summary reports 292 passed, 70 failures, 4 skipped, and 25 errors.
Final response says the delivered executable rebuilds from halite_reimpl.py and admits residual map and combat risk.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only cell trajectory reviewed for envelope and source projection; semantic activity is in raw rollouts.
Parent orchestrated child agents, maintained its own implementation, switched build targets, interrupted generator_probe, and finalized delivery.
cli_probe investigated CLI behavior, saw scratch output clobbering, built halite_clone.py, and returned a verified candidate.
protocol_probe reconstructed bot protocol, replay structure, quiet output, and timing behavior for the parent.
Nested cli_probe branch supplied additional CLI parsing and edge-case observations under the main cli_probe effort.
generator_probe investigated map generation, reported scratch collisions, sampled default sizes, and was interrupted mid-probe.
Nested protocol_probe under generator_probe returned detailed CLI and protocol observations visible to the parent.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is byte-identical to parallel and requires black-box reverse engineering plus original replacement code.
Serial metadata shows no subagents, artifact_ok false, and zero official passed tests out of 391.
Status records artifact validation failure with extra submitted members and official compile_failed evaluation.
Official evaluator summary reports compile_failed with 391 tests not run.
Final response says halite_env.py was promoted to executable and locally smoke-tested against observed fixtures.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only serial cell trajectory reviewed for run envelope; no semantic subagent activity was present.
Single serial actor probed behavior, wrote halite_env.py and reimpl_executable, compiled, promoted executable, and finalized.

parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the black-box clean-room reverse-engineering requirement, the ban on source lookup and wrapping, and the need to reproduce CLI, bot protocol, replay/log, map, and combat behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent split work among CLI, protocol, and generator probes while also implementing a parent version; cli_probe independently produced a full halite_clone.py candidate and generator_probe owned map-generation details.
parallel.implementation: The parent built reimpl/halite_reimpl.py while cli_probe built reimpl/halite_clone.py. The parent compared both, briefly favored the clone, then switched the build back to halite_reimpl.py before finalizing.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivery went through compile scripts that copied the selected Python source into ./executable. The final delivered path was halite_reimpl.py, not the child clone that had been reported as verified.
parallel.verification: Parallel ran many local probes for help/version, parser errors, quiet and verbose output, timeouts, seeded games, and representative combat, and the official evaluator ran enough to pass 292 tests.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The parent final admitted exact unsampled map generation and rarer combat edge cases were still not exhaustively proven, and official evaluation still had failures and errors.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same clean-room black-box requirements and focused on CLI surface, bot protocol, replay JSON, log/error handling, turn resolution, and observed map fixtures.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor performed probing, wrote the implementation, created the entrypoint, compiled it, moved the original executable aside, and promoted the replacement.
serial.implementation: The serial run added halite_env.py plus a thin reimpl_executable wrapper and implemented known fixtures and a deterministic fallback map generator.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial actor compiled the two Python files, moved the original binary to reference_executable, and moved reimpl_executable to executable, but left extra artifacts in the submitted tree.
serial.verification: Serial py_compile passed and local probes checked version/no-arg behavior, a 3x3 direction case, and a two-player replay/collision fixture.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Serial final still admitted unobserved seeds and sizes were not exhaustively diffed, and the official artifact/evaluation failed with compile_failed before tests ran.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the reverse-engineering and clean-room constraints and attempted to reproduce broad Halite engine behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and clean-room constraints and pursued a similar black-box reproduction target.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No major requirements difference; the outcomes diverged in delivery and coverage quality rather than prompt understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split CLI, protocol, and generator probing across subagents while the parent also implemented and integrated.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no subagents and kept probing, implementation, integration, and delivery in one actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel increased evidence gathering breadth but introduced shared ownership of implementation and final executable decisions.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received child findings about protocol and CLI behavior and the parent could inspect completed child summaries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated its own observations locally and then wrote the core implementation from that single context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context transfer worked for some facts, but competing summaries and workspace state required parent arbitration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had two implementation lines: parent halite_reimpl.py and child halite_clone.py, with later patches to the parent implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote halite_env.py and a wrapper entrypoint as one coherent implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had competing implementation candidates and a late final target switch, while serial had a single implementation path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the completed cli_probe result but explicitly interrupted generator_probe before its active default-size sampling completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not need child result lifecycle management and finalized after local probing and delivery steps.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result timing failure for generator work; serial had no equivalent child result to interrupt or join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared one workspace, saw probe-output collisions, and changed the build script between child and parent sources.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial promoted one wrapper into executable and moved the original binary aside without concurrent workspace writers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-state coordination costs around both scratch probes and the final executable; serial had a simpler but artifact-invalid final tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran representative local probes and official evaluation reached 292 passing tests with remaining failures and errors.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran py_compile and local probes, but official evaluation stopped at compile_failed with no tests run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader and evaluator-reachable; serial's local checks did not prevent artifact/compile failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used long multi-agent probing, ended after interrupting generator_probe, and closed with explicit residual unsampled behavior risk.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished faster as a single actor but closed with unobserved-seed risk and an artifact that later failed validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's closure left coordination-induced unfinished generator work; serial's closure failure was ordinary packaging/evaluator readiness.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official outcomes failed. Parallel nevertheless produced an artifact the evaluator could run, passing 292 of 391 tests before remaining failures and errors. Serial produced a locally compiled and promoted script, but artifact validation included extra tree members and the official evaluator recorded compile_failed with all 391 tests not run. The comparative difference is evaluator reachability and partial behavioral coverage, not a pass/fail split.
parallel_contributors: Parallel delivered an evaluable executable with broad but incomplete behavioral coverage.
Parallel retained residual map-generation and combat uncertainty after coordination issues.
serial_contributors: Serial promoted a single Python entrypoint but left extra artifacts including reference_executable and .git in the submitted tree.
Serial official evaluation stopped at compile_failed, so no behavioral tests ran.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts relied on observed fixtures and did not exhaustively reproduce unobserved map and combat cases.
Serial's artifact packaging and compile failure is an ordinary delivery defect in the serial control, not a parallel taxonomy label.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator source of truth is the completed cell/status.json evaluation; stale aggregates were not used for the outcome relation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: both_fail; retained parallel patterns are adverse process events, not an official outcome differential

candidates.reason: Parallel had active implementation owners: the parent wrote halite_reimpl.py and cli_probe wrote halite_clone.py.
The parent explicitly compared candidate implementations and owned integration into the build scripts.
The parent and cli_probe both handled compile scripts and executable placement, so assembly was not ownerless.
The parent owned the end-to-end transition from probing through implementation, compile, tests, and final response.
Implementation and probing overlapped; productive work was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight.
Parallel did not defer all implementation until after an investigation phase; parent and child implementations progressed during probing.
The adverse generator episode is better classified as explicit early termination, not a capacity starvation of the critical path.
High fan-out and token use are visible, but there is no direct collective budget-exhaustion event displacing final required work.
generator_probe was interrupted while active, but the evidence does not show a delegated scope uniquely too broad relative to available time.
The retained failures are not caused by an already-known requirement omitted from a child brief and then followed by that child.
The competing implementation issue became a concrete final executable target replacement, not merely an absent interface contract.
Child findings were visible to the parent; no known finding is proven lost or omitted during transfer.
The handoffs were lengthy but the parent inspected and used key returned facts, so bulk alone did not make a result unusable.
No retained event depends on the parent consuming a child summary that described a superseded workspace state.
Although clone and reimpl candidates competed, the direct event was build target replacement rather than unresolved incompatible reports.
The parent final admitted residual risk and had performed integrated local probes; the visible gap is better captured by child interruption and delivery overwrite.
There is no replacement child retry that lacked inherited checkpoints and repeated prior work as the adverse event.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly interrupted generator_probe while it was sampling default map-size behavior, leaving that needed map-generation work unfinished at finalization.
candidates.realized_consequence: Generator default-size sampling was aborted, and the final parallel response retained unsampled map-generation uncertainty.
candidates.near_match_reason: No Failure Takeover is downstream; the defining event is the explicit parent interrupt of a running child.

candidates.reason: A candidate was promoted and then replaced; the issue is not that a directly promotable complete artifact merely missed the deadline.
The parent ran post-switch verification probes after changing the build target, so the evidence does not fit a pure post-verification merge.
cli_probe's implementation was returned, inspected, and initially adopted; the later problem is deliverable target overwrite.
Concrete verifier and protocol results were returned or visible; generator_probe's missing result is covered by explicit early termination.
The cancelled generator child is already represented by Early Child Termination, the direct boundary whose correction changes the chain.
The completed cli_probe and nested protocol results were visible and used or considered by the parent.
The parent actively listed agents and issued an interrupt; the problem was not passive waiting through timeout without inspection.
Parent and child had competing implementation paths, but the concrete retained event is a final executable build-target replacement.
Scratch collisions were observed, but no exact two-agent same-source-file edit collision is proven.
The important replacement affected the submitted executable build target, so Deliverable Overwrite is more specific than source overwrite.
The parent first restored compile.sh to ship cli_probe's verified halite_clone.py, then later changed compile.sh back to copy halite_reimpl.py into ./executable.
candidates.realized_consequence: The child-verified clone was no longer the final executable source; the shipped build used the parent's halite_reimpl.py instead.
candidates.near_match_reason: The child implementation was not missing from the join; it was returned, inspected, temporarily adopted, and then overwritten at the deliverable target.

candidates.reason: The evidence identifies targeted build-script and executable-source replacement, not a broad cleanup or rebuild invalidating multiple final outputs.
Multiple live agents wrote shared scratch/probe outputs without isolation, producing clobbered logs and forcing probe redesign.
candidates.realized_consequence: Probe outputs had unstable provenance, causing rework to isolate log paths and consolidate generator probing.
candidates.near_match_reason: The evidence proves clobbered scratch/probe outputs, but not a specific two-agent edit to the same source file.

candidates.reason: Shared scratch files were unstable, but no generated artifact is shown being consumed as stable reference input by another actor.

retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Generator default-size sampling was aborted, and final map-generation behavior remained incompletely proven.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: No Failure Takeover is a downstream description; the directly evidenced boundary is the interrupt of an active child.

retained_patterns.reason: The final executable target was switched away from the child-verified clone and rebuilt from the parent's halite_reimpl.py source.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The child-verified clone was no longer the final executable source; the shipped build used halite_reimpl.py.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The child result was returned and inspected; the concrete failure was replacement of the final deliverable target.

retained_patterns.reason: Multiple live agents shared scratch paths, observed clobbered probe output, and changed probes to recover stable provenance.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Probe outputs had unstable provenance, causing rework to isolate log paths and consolidate generator probing.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The evidence does not identify a specific same-source-file edit collision by two live agents.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: No Failure Takeover was suppressed for the generator interruption chain.
Missing Implementation Join and Cross-File Scope Collision were suppressed in favor of Deliverable Overwrite for the final entrypoint switch.
Same-File Collision and Artifact Leakage were suppressed for scratch collisions because the evidence shows unstable shared outputs, not a proven same-file edit or consumed contaminated artifact.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were considered; retained labels cover only directly evidenced parallel coordination consequences.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Each retained label has a unique episode id, distinct consequence, non-identical evidence set, and a separate corrective boundary.
